title: Mint the neutral `box` container and retire JSON-authored `div` from the schema catalog
body:
Fixes #3965

Executes the **2026-08-29T14:52 maintainer ruling (方案 A, verbatim 「同意」)** — mint a neutral `box` type, migrate the catalog off JSON-authored `div`, close the #6732 ratchet — and **no earlier superseded ruling**. Base: `origin/main` @ `2c1c967`.

## Re-derived counts, both units, with the control (measured on `2c1c967`)

| query (structural walk, not text grep) | files | nodes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `"type": "div"` under `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas` | **27** | **85** |
| positive control, identical query shape: `"type": "card"` | 53 | 93 |

The control's **93 nodes / 53 files** matches every prior reading (08-10, 08-18, 08-28, 08-29), so the population is a measurement, not a broken pattern. The card's original "48" was a FILE count; both units are stated everywhere below. Union of keys across all 85 div nodes: `type`, `className`, `children`, `body` — re-verified structurally; exactly **4 nodes author `body`** (all of `components-basic-sidebar`, at path `.body[1].body[0]`).

⚠️ Not claimed as motivation: the card's "one deprecation warning per thumbnail" symptom was already false before this PR — #3998 made the notice once-per-module-load and #4000 scoped it by provenance. What this PR closes is the **authoring-contract cost**: catalog exemplars teaching a deprecated type to the corpus AI generation copies from.

## 1. Mint (ruling point 1) — landed as one stroke

- **Interface face**: `BoxSchema` in `packages/types/src/layout.ts`, `LayoutSchema` union, `SchemaRegistry['box']`, index export.
- **Zod mirror**: `BoxSchema` in `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`, discriminated-union member, zod index export, and the **zod-mirror-parity pairing registered in both halves** of `MIRRORS` (the #6424 family form) — clause-② review basis.
- **Registry**: `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/box.tsx` — `namespace: 'ui'`, `isContainer: true` (it renders an authored child list; #3900/#6764 reasoning), DOM pass-through on the `toDomProps` whitelist from day one.
- **Docs page**: `content/docs/components/layout/box.mdx` (+ meta.json), with a ts-fenced schema block that `check:doc-snippets` compiles.
- **Catalog exemplars**: `components-layout-box/basic-box` and `nested-boxes` (+ curated meta, regenerated index — 433 entries).

**The three ruled contract clauses are pinned** in `packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/box-neutral-container.test.tsx`: renders `children`; authored `className` emitted **verbatim (string equality on the DOM class attribute, not containment)**; zero injected classes (the no-className arm asserts no class attribute at all). A fourth pin makes the sharp edge deliberate: `box` reads `children` ONLY — never `body` — with a `div` control render proving the fixture shape is renderable and the difference is the read, not a broken fixture.

Zod runtime reverse-verification against the **rebuilt** dist: admits a well-formed box node; refuses `type: 'div'` against `BoxSchema` and a non-string `className` (path `["className"]`); `LayoutSchema` union admits `box`.

## 2. Migration (ruling point 2) — 25 files / 80 nodes; 2 files / 5 nodes stay under a standing exemption

Mechanical retype `"type": "div"` → `"type": "box"` across 25 files / 80 nodes. The 4 `body`-authoring sidebar nodes moved their content into `children` in the same stroke (the #6771 B-ruling direction) — each a 2-line diff, formatting preserved.

**Zero render difference, verified by the ruled per-fixture method** (element count + text content dual assertion, through the real SchemaRenderer, per fixture, before vs after): a temporary vitest harness rendered each of the 25 pre-migration snapshots and its migrated counterpart — **26/26 assertions green: 25/25 pairs equal on BOTH element count and text content**, and the 4 body-moved fixtures additionally pinned their "Main content area" sentinel on the page after migration (the exact content the superseded rulings would have silently dropped at an unchanged element count). The harness was deleted after the measurement; log excerpt below.

**Deviation from the ruling's literal figure, called out rather than silently chosen**: the ruling says "27 文件 / 85 节点". This PR migrates **25 / 80** and leaves `components-basic-div/` (`custom-card.json`, `nested-divs.json` — 2 files / 5 nodes) authoring `div`, per the standing 2026-08-09 exemption ("div.mdx 的 2 个刻意 legacy 示例在任何选项下永久豁免", recorded on PR #3998 and carried by #6732's gate): that category IS the documentation of the deprecated type — its fixtures render the Legacy Examples on `div.mdx` — and retyping them to `box` would make the deprecated component's own docs page demonstrate the wrong component. The governing ruling explicitly superseded two named rulings and did not name this exemption; I read the gross 27/85 as the population figure (with its own "recount on the day's ref" caveat) rather than as a revocation. Flagged in the report's open questions; converting those 2 files is a 5-minute follow-up if the maintainer rules the exemption dead — and their guidance-staleness is filed as #6877 either way.

## 3. Ratchet close-out (ruling point 3)

`examples/schema-catalog/test/deprecated-component-types.test.ts` drops the frozen-stock `BASELINE` machinery and now refuses **ANY** JSON-authored `div` or `span` outside the documentation exemption — zero tolerance, both types. Kept: the premise arm (deprecation still declared, asked of the registry), the omission arm (a third deprecated type cannot go unguarded), the exemption non-vacuity pin (exactly 2 files / 5 nodes), the counter-probe.

**Red-arm proof on unfixed fixtures** (each mutation confirmed on disk by anchored grep counts before reading any result; restores pinned to HEAD and proven — probe file absent / `git diff HEAD` empty + HEAD-blob hash equality, empty hash treated as failure):
- new fixture authoring 1 div + 1 span outside the exemption → gate exit 1, offender named with both types;
- exempt category grown 5 → 6 nodes → gate exit 1, "expected 6 to be 5".

## 4. `box` joins both DOM-leak instruments as a converged renderer

- `layout-dom-leak-5574` census: `box: 84 rendered / 0 noElement` (the migrated 80 + 4 exemplar nodes — every node proves it renders its element and leaks nothing); `text` 699 → 702 (the exemplars author 3 text nodes).
- `widget-dom-leak-sweep` (packages/app-shell): `ui:box` added to `COMPONENTS_PLAIN_TYPES`; it sweeps **clean with no ledger entry** — unlike its predecessor `div`, which sits in the BARE_SPREAD ledger row. ⚠️ This file is outside the claim's declared surface; the edit was mechanically forced by the sweep's own parity arm ("every widget it registers is swept — a new one cannot slip past" fails on any new `ui:*` registration). Declared here and in the report as the same-round file-face amendment.

## Verification at final HEAD `1bcb1f7` (all exits captured before any pipe; gate-printed verdict lines quoted)

- Suites: `pnpm exec vitest run examples/schema-catalog/ packages/types/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` — "Test Files 92 passed (92)", "Tests 2952 passed (2952)". `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/` — "Test Files 217 passed (217)", "Tests 1999 passed (1999)". Lock verdicts "command-exit 0".
- Type-checks (script name echoed for each): `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog` — exit 0, zero "error TS" lines; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` confirms the new/edited test files are inside their programs (1 hit each — not silently excluded).
- Gates, each with its own verdict: `check:doc-types` "Every documented component type is registered"; `check:doc-snippets` OK after building its declared closure (first run was exit 2 "PRECONDITION NOT MET" — treated as not-measured, built, re-run); `check:doc-fences` OK (the new page is ts-fenced; the plaintext form was rejected by the ratchet and fixed); `check:docs-route-closure`, `check:sdui-registration-pins` "All 14 registration(s) … present" (console built first), `check:eager-closure` "chunk ui-components 386.1 KB / 389.6 KB ceiling", `check:side-effects-array`, `check:control-bytes` "OK (scanned 5732 tracked text files)", `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:readme-exports` OK (after building plugin-ai — same not-measured class), `regenerate:check` "index.ts is up to date (433 entries)"; `check-changeset-presence` "8 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed … declares 1 changeset(s)"; `check-changeset-no-major` "No changeset declares a major bump".
- Lint, CI-parity: `turbo run lint` on the four touched packages — "Tasks: 5 successful, 5 total", 0 errors. A separate `--no-inline-config --format json` reading of the 13 changed files: 0 new errors (the single error shown pre-exists byte-identically at BASE behind a deliberate inline exemption; `box.tsx`'s two warnings equal the `div.tsx` sibling control).
- Declared narrowing: repo-wide `pnpm lint` not run locally (population = per-package eslint via turbo; the four touched packages were run exactly as CI runs them; `eslint.config.js` declares no `project`/`projectService`, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict). CI runs the full farm regardless.

Changeset: `.changeset/3965-mint-box-neutral-container.md` (minor, `@object-ui/types` + `@object-ui/components`).

Out of scope, filed after a full-enumeration dedup (251 open issues via repo-scoped REST, positive controls hit): **#6877** — the div/span deprecation guidance still teaches the measured-non-drop-in replacements and never names `box`; every surface involved is pinned by the #4000 ruling and the #6823 agreement test, so it is a judged follow-up, not a rider here.

The `kind:'html'` tier and landmark conversions were **not touched** (ruling point 4). `skills/**` untouched.
